scope: Preview archive inspected; full 10 GB archive and model performance not evaluated.

numbered_indoor_area_m2.method: Point-in-polygon joins of room IDs to DXF outlines; excluded the two balconies identified from PDF labels (5.01, 5.16).

sample_probe.limitations: One paired sheet only; excluded balcony IDs were selected explicitly after inspecting labels. Not a general parser, not a held-out evaluation.

real_sheet_probe.visual_finding: Multiple plan, elevation and typical-detail views repeat fixtures. Visible symbol instances do not necessarily equal distinct installed objects.

training_status: No neural model trained or benchmarked; training times in the response are planning estimates.
